review_candidates.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Storage
review_candidates.description: Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence . As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. About This Role The Cloud Storage team at Crusoe is seeking a Senior Staff Software Engineer to serve as a primary architect and visionary for our storage strategy. While a Staff Engineer leads features, a Senior Staff Engineer defines the multi-year technical roadmap that underpins our AI-scale infrastructure. You will be a multiplier, responsible for the architectural strategy, integrity and global scalability of our bespoke storage services. You will work at the physics of the stack, bridging the gap between high-performance NVMe hardware and globally distributed, S3-competitive object stores. What You’ll Be Working On Architectural Vision & Strategy: Define and drive the long-term technical strategy for Crusoe’s storage engine. Identify industry trends (e.g., CXL, NVMe-oF) and integrate them into a cohesive roadmap. System Programming Expertise: Leverage proven experience in system programming with languages such as C, C++, Go, and/or Rust to build the foundations of our V2 storage re-architecture. Storage Protocols: Architect and implement solutions utilizing industry-standard storage protocols such as NFS, SMB, iSCSI, and NVMe/TCP. Open Source Stewardship: Drive and maintain a track record of contributions to the open-source community (e.g., Ceph, GlusterFS, Lustre, Spectrum Scale, OpenEBS). Technical Authority: Serve as the final arbiter for critical architecture decisions across the Foundations organization. Lead complex design reviews that intersect storage, networking, and virtualization. Deep Performance Engineering: Lead "tiger teams" to solve the most ambiguous and difficult bottlenecks in the stack—from kernel-level IO context switching to global tail-latency in distributed clusters. Strategic Collaboration: Work closely with Executive Leadership and Product to align technical capabilities with business milestones, such as our imminent path to IPO. What You’ll Bring To The Team Cloud Storage Expertise: 12+ years of experience building and operating large-scale, complex distributed cloud computing infrastructure products. Troubleshooting & Tuning: Strong troubleshooting and performance tuning skills; ability to profile and optimize the entire IO path. High-Drive Mindset: Self-motivation to thrive in a fast-paced environment with a high degree of ownership and minimal supervision. Masters of Consistency & Durability: Deep theoretical and practical knowledge of distributed state and data protection at petabyte scale. Software Engineering Fundamentals: Mastery of professional software engineering practices for the full SDLC, including coding standards, build processes, and testing. Communication & Collaboration: Ability to champion and lead initiatives across the engineering organization, such as tech talks and technical reading groups. Bonus Points Public Cloud & AI/ML: Expertise in one or more Public Cloud offerings (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI) and familiarity with AI/ML frameworks (PyTorch, Tensorflow, JAX) and MLOps. High-Throughput I/O: Experience with cutting-edge I/O architectures like DAOS or SPDK. Networking Foundations: Background in RDMA and high-performance networking, including SmartNICs and RoCEv2. Distributed Systems Mastery: Experience with highly available and scalable systems such as Cassandra, MongoDB, Redis, or Kafka. Theoretical Depth: Strong knowledge of distributed systems fundamentals including CAP Theorem, Paxos/RAFT, consistent hashing, and sharding strategies. Education: Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Benefits: Competitive compensation Restricted Stock Units Paid time off & paid holidays Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance Employer contributions to HSA account Paid parental leave Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability Professional development & tuition reimbursement Mental health & wellness support Commuter benefits (parking & transit) Cell phone stipend 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary Volunteer time off Compensation Range Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $245,000 - $290,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Design and maintain robust data and feature pipelines for large-scale geospatial and temporal data. Partner with wildfire science and product teams to define modeling objectives and evaluation metrics tied to real-world impact. Build reproducible experimentation frameworks and model evaluation workflows. Scale models from research to production with a focus on performance, reliability, and explainability. Lead the evolution of ML systems, tooling, and processes — ensuring that our wildfire fuelscape models remain state-of-the-art and maintainable. Collaborate with MLOps peers to streamline training, inference, and monitoring in production environments. What We Offer Competitive, location-specific compensation and benefits Flexible, autonomous and collaborative working environment rooted in trust - we build our work days around our lives, not the other way around Home office stipend, coworking and ongoing education budgets A company culture that genuinely embodies each of our core values To be part of truly mission-driven work that reduces wildfires, protects earth’s natural resources and helps solve our climate crisis

review_candidates.title: Full Stack Product Engineer (m/w/d) – Bling Schule
review_candidates.description: Deine Mission Bling Schule baut den ersten Payment-Dienstleister, mit dem Schulen und Kitas in Deutschland ihren Zahlungsverkehr vollständig bargeldlos abwickeln. Mit zwei Produkten sind wir bereits bei über 100 Einrichtungen live. Unser Entwicklungsteam besteht mit dir aus drei Seniors, die das Produkt gleichverantwortlich nach vorne treiben. Es gibt keine Ticket-Pipeline, die dir Arbeit zuteilt: Ihr entscheidet gemeinsam, was gebaut wird und wie. Als dritter Senior im Team verantwortest du eigene Bereiche der Plattform end-to-end. Die fachliche Komplexität unseres Produkts liegt in der Zahlungsabwicklung zwischen Eltern, Einrichtungen und Anbietern: mandantenfähige Strukturen, unterschiedliche Abrechnungslogiken je Einrichtung und regulatorische Anforderungen an Nachvollziehbarkeit und Datenhaltung. Genau dafür suchen wir Unterstützung von dir. Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest Bereiche unserer Plattform vollständig, also von der technischen Konzeption über die Architektur bis zum Betrieb dessen, was du gebaut hast. Du triffst gemeinsam mit CTO und Lead Developer die Architekturentscheidungen, die die Entwicklung von Bling Schule über die nächsten Jahre prägen. Du gestaltest unsere Infrastruktur weiter: Services, Datenmodell und Cloud-Umgebung, auf denen bargeldlose Zahlungen zuverlässig und skalierbar laufen. Du setzt die Standards für unsere Code-Qualität, Testing und Observability, an denen sich das Team orientiert. Du arbeitest direkt mit unseren Kund:innen, verstehst den Alltag in Schulen und Kitas und übersetzt ihn in überzeugende und anwendbare Lösungen. Dein Profil Du hast mehrere Jahre professionelle Erfahrung als Full Stack Developer und Systeme gebaut, die im Produktionsbetrieb laufen und von echten Nutzer:innen verwendet werden. Unser Stack ist TypeScript mit NestJS auf Node.js, relationale Datenbanken und AWS und mit diesen Systemen fühlst du dich wohl. Wenn du aus Java/Spring Boot oder C#/.NET kommst und TypeScript bereits eingesetzt hast, passt das ebenfalls. Du arbeitest mit modernen AI-Coding-Tools und weißt, wo sie dir Arbeit abnehmen und wo du besser selbst prüfst. Du hast bereits eigenständig Architekturentscheidungen getroffen und kannst erklären, warum du dich so entschieden hast. Erfahrung in Bereichen mit komplexer Fachlichkeit oder regulatorischen Anforderungen – Payments, Abrechnung, Finanzprodukte, Gesundheitswesen oder Vergleichbares – ist ein starkes Plus. Du gestaltest gerne mit, bringst eigene Ideen ein und arbeitest selbstständig in einem Umfeld, in dem Anforderungen nicht immer von Anfang an klar sind. Du legst Wert auf sauberes Engineering und bist dabei pragmatisch genug, um zu wissen, wann etwas gut genug ist. Was dich erwartet Gestalte die technische Richtung des ersten bargeldlosen Payment-Dienstleister für Schulen und Kitas aktiv mit und trage echte Verantwortung dafür, wie Schulen, Kitas und Familien ihren Zahlungsalltag einfacher erleben. Ein Team aus drei Seniors ohne Hierarchie dazwischen: kurze Entscheidungswege, keine Abstimmungsschleifen, keine Legacy-Altlasten, die dich ausbremsen. Direkter Draht zu Kund:innen und Geschäftsführung – du siehst, was deine Arbeit bei Schulen, Kitas und Familien tatsächlich bewirkt. Ein flexibles Arbeitsmodell: aus unserem Büro in Berlin Mitte, von zu Hause oder remote aus Deutschland. Erhalte ein MacBook und jede weitere Ausstattung, die du brauchst, um erfolgreich arbeiten zu können. Wachse schnell durch eigenverantwortliche Projekte, interne Workshops und kontinuierliche Lernmöglichkeiten. Verbinde dich mit deinem Team durch regelmäßige Events, die unsere Kultur stärken und gemeinsame Erfolge feiern. Bleib verbunden mit einem exklusiven Bling Mobile-Tarif inklusive Premium-Mobilfunkleistungen und weiteren Vorteilen.

review_candidates.title: Custom Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Project Role : Custom Software Engineer Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs. Must have skills : Automotive ECU Software Good to have skills : NA Minimum 12 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: Lead systems engineering for production-oriented tire intelligence solutions delivered to global OEM and Tier-1 customers. Translate customer and product needs into complete, traceable system requirements and architectures coordinate embedded software, algorithms, sensors, gateways, cloud interfaces, functional safety, cybersecurity, integration, and validation from concept through vehicle launch and field support. Roles & Responsibilities: Own end-to-end systems engineering for OEM tire intelligence applications, including system context, use cases, operating scenarios, interfaces, performance targets, diagnostics, assumptions, and acceptance criteria. Elicit, analyze, and negotiate OEM requirements perform gap and impact analysis establish bidirectional traceability across customer, system, software, hardware, algorithm, safety, cybersecurity, and test work products. Develop and maintain system architecture and interface definitions across tire-mounted sensors, vehicle networks, ECUs/TCUs, receivers/gateways, embedded algorithms, cloud services, and customer applications. Convert tire intelligence functions such as tire health, pressure/load estimation, leak detection, road or friction insights, and aquaplaning-related features into implementable and verifiable system specifications. Lead technical reviews with OEMs, Tier-1s, suppliers, and global engineering teams drive decisions, interface alignment, risk closure, and resolution of system-level issues. Plan and support integration and verification through model-, software-, processor-, hardware-in-the-loop, bench, vehicle, and fleet testing ensure requirements-based coverage and evidence. Apply Automotive SPICE and systems V-model practices, including change control, baselining, configuration management, design reviews, defect management, and release readiness. Integrate functional safety and cybersecurity needs in coordination with specialists, supporting ISO 26262 and ISO/SAE 21434 work products, safety/security analyses, technical concepts, and customer evidence. Support production launch and lifecycle activities, including calibration/interface changes, root-cause analysis, field issue resolution, technical documentation, and lessons learned for reusable platforms. Mentor engineers and strengthen India-based systems capability through structured reviews, knowledge transfer, and consistent global engineering practices. SUCCESS PROFILE :Systems thinker who combines technical depth, disciplined execution, customer orientation, and pragmatic decision-making in a global matrix environment. Professional & Technical Skills: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Systems, Electrical, Electronics, Computer, Automotive, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline. 7-10 years of automotive/embedded product-development experience, including 4+ years in systems or requirements engineering for OEM or Tier-1 programs. Hands-on experience with requirements engineering, architecture, interface management, integration, verification, and customer technical reviews. Working knowledge of Automotive SPICE, ISO 26262, ISO/SAE 21434, and production software/hardware release processes. Proficiency with Polarion, DOORS, or equivalent familiarity with SysML/UML modeling and tools such as Enterprise Architect or Cameo. Knowledge of CAN/CAN FD, J1939, UDS/OBD-II, Ethernet, BLE/RF, sensor interfaces, telematics, and embedded/cloud connectivity. Ability to interpret MATLAB/Simulink models and analyze data using MATLAB or Python experience with Vector and/or dSPACE environments is preferred. Strong technical writing, analytical problem-solving, and communication skills able to collaborate across India, Europe, Asia, and North America. Preferred Experience Tire/vehicle dynamics, TPMS or tire-mounted sensing, signal processing, estimation algorithms, gateways/TCUs, or connected-vehicle platforms. OEM production programs from concept and RFQ through SOP, including HIL/vehicle validation, calibration, and issue management. AUTOSAR, embedded C/C++, model-based development, cloud/IoT architectures, CI/CD, and test automation. Additional Information: The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Automotive ECU Software. This position is based at Bangalore /Hyderabad facility A 15 years full time education is required.
